sloka: आसीत् च अत्र आश्रमम् पुण्यम् सुरैः अपि सुपूजितम् ।ऋषिः निशाकरो नाम यस्मिन् उग्र तपा अभवत् ॥४-६०-८॥
transliteration: āsīt ca atra āśramam puṇyam suraiḥ api supūjitam ।ṛṣiḥ niśākaro nāma yasmin ugra tapā abhavat ॥4-60-8॥

translations.english: 'There was a hermitage nearby, where a revered sage, who was even worshpped by gods lived. His name was Nishakara. He did rigorous penance here.
